chapter: Henry Kimball and the Kimball family
title: Father Henry Kimball's birth and death
summary: His father's approximate birth year, that he played bass violin and later sousaphone, and died at about 53 in 1932-33.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: I wonder, if I'm going to interrupt you, I was going to ask more about your father, if you can tell us even some of the things about his life. That is, if you know just when he was born and when he died, we don't have that information exactly. We might, I haven't seen his birth date, we might be able to check when he died. But if you can remember approximately the day of the year, if you don't remember the exact birthday or anything.
My father would be 85 years old if he were living now. 85 now.
And he was born on March the 24th, the same month. And I was born on the 24th of March.
Seventh or in it. If you were born in 81 he'd be 80 years old. So he'd be 76. So he'd be 76. 1876 about. Approximately. About that time. I don't remember the exact date. Yes.
Did he ever play anything besides string bass?
Yes, he played the string bass. Did you? Yes, he played the sousaphone. Did he play in parades too or just an artist?
I don't remember his having played in parades because he always played the bass violin until the later years, about maybe 10 or 15 years before he died.
Oh, and by the way, just remember the year he died then?
It was in 32 or 33. 32 or 33. He was about 53 years old when he died. He wasn't old at all then.
No, he wasn't. We wouldn't consider that even hardly middle age. Some people say he's still young.
One kind of thing a long time ago when we think of him as being one of the pioneers, one of the old men in jazz, but he wasn't old at all.
